title: Product Reject and Filtering Station
abstraction: Discrete-time LTL over scan-cycle states. Numeric conditions are derived atoms; timer conditions use internal atoms mapped to the TON/TOF .Q flag of the reference implementation.
assumptions: The PLC scan is periodic (20 ms in the test cases).
Inputs change only at scan boundaries.
A timer atom becomes true after its configured delay has elapsed.
The reference implementation is used only to validate the specification; it is not shown to the coding agent.

properties.name: Defective part is rejected
properties.rationale: A defective part on a running conveyor activates the pusher on the next scan.

properties.name: Pusher retracts
properties.rationale: The reject pusher is a temporary pulse, not a permanent output.

properties.name: Batch full stops the conveyor
properties.rationale: No further parts may be transported after the batch is full.
